required_port_extension.cohesion: G alone is insufficient; obtain peak traction/opening or complete traction-separation envelope, direction and loading/unloading history.

required_port_extension.cells: require membrane strain mapping, cell identity, loading duration and thermal viability kinetics

thermal_edge_predictions_R2.prediction: At native fraction0.5 Gamma_cut=75J/m2 in both histories, while Gamma_tear=5042.80/744.48J/m2. The intrinsicgf survival-only rule and length/kinetic correlation are unmeasured.
thermal_edge_predictions_R2.electrosurgery_example: 85C1.649ms scenario consumes marked kinetics;55C7135s is counterfactual comparator, not surgery.
thermal_edge_predictions_R2.mechanical_state_requirement: Same finalmax opening and group survival cannot recover prior mechanical dissipation; retainD_mech andQ_heat_storage.
thermal_edge_predictions_R2.limits: No thermal variation of gf,tau,Ef,strength,conformity; no boiling/electrical/heat/perfusion model; no histological or cell-necrosis zone.
thermal_edge_predictions_R2.heat_update_contract: For finite slow hazard ramp, integrate n(u), solve local equilibrium and bookD/Q throughout ramp. A single finalsurvivor multiplication omits thermal-driven slip.
thermal_edge_predictions_R2.instantaneous_edit: COUPLED_BRIDGE_RESULTS_R2.json FAIL; finite relaxation energy requires inertial/damping port. Quasistatic ramp is a changed physical contract, not an instantaneous edit certificate.

cohesive_spectrum_R2.opening_to_slip: s=max(delta-50um,0) on loading; unloading requires h=maxpastdelta, not virgin tail(delta)
cohesive_spectrum_R2.history_for_cut: Cut/tear virgin-cohort ports do not create new energy on an already opened seam.
cohesive_spectrum_R2.admissibility: 2tauL/r<=sigma_f required; B leaves sliding after+8.7%friction, new rupture law required.
cohesive_spectrum_R2.compression: Per uniform-history kinetic group: sorted positive tails0/1/2. SetupO(NlogN), queryO(KlogN), memoryO(N); no history replay. General material/kinetic edits may require rebuild and old hazard acquisition.
cohesive_spectrum_R2.consumer_scale_warning: Do not replace INCISION syntheticG200J/m2/E200kPa by porcine30kJ/m2 without explicit scale/load rerun.

prospective_acquisition_R2.scope: Same specimen/same direction/mode; prospective synthetic design under exact moments and assumed0.1-25mm support. Not performed on tissue.
prospective_acquisition_R2.goal: Bound remaining pullout work at3mm slip; acquire curvature-sensitive workcurve information absent inG/peak.

process_volume_R3.use_previous_R2_radius: Only its labelled tensile/bending toy; no empirical radius or rho<<h_pz suppression theorem.
